spec_match.rationale: Probes OfflineAudioContextOptions.renderSizeHint, the spec's hardware≡default rule for offline contexts, the §2.5 [1, 6×sampleRate] NotSupportedError range, and suspend()'s round-up-to-quantum-boundary quantization.

interactive.rationale: Three buttons run real constructions and a real offline render with suspend/resume, filling three result tables with per-row spec-vs-observed outcomes.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Card promises the offline twists (hardware≡default, out-of-range throws, suspend grid) and the page delivers all three.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers omitted hint, both enum values, non-power-of-two 192, boundary value 6×sampleRate, both out-of-range directions, unsupported browsers (hint-ignored labelling), and the all-128 degenerate case is explicitly explained.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5078190552907776, the OfflineAudioContextOptions.renderSizeHint anchor, and §2.5 render-quantum-sizes.

conformance.rationale: The new feature suite asserts the same contracts this page demonstrates (default 128, offline hardware≡default, verbatim 512, both throws, suspend boundary); 3 of 8 fail honestly on sandbox Chromium 141.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Real-time CDP run on headless Chromium 141 with and without the flag: matrix shows granted 128 everywhere with honest 'not honoured verbatim' rows, out-of-range hints honestly flagged as not throwing on this build, and all three suspend renders landed on frame 512 (the 128-grid boundary); console/network clean except the environmental fonts failure. Not chrome-devtools-mcp (unavailable here).

telemetry_health.rationale: oqg-support, oqg-hardware-eq-default, oqg-matrix-spec, oqg-out-of-range and oqg-suspend-grid each assert their own branch; fallback paths assert false rather than being skipped.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only, emerald/rose verdicts at bold weight on paper (AA), tables in overflow containers, no button colour overrides beyond the shared style.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons, three captioned tables with scoped headers, an aria-live polite status line shared by all three actions, and no gesture-dependent behaviour (offline contexts need none).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x1400: zero document overflow, tables scroll internally, buttons at 44px.

openQuestions.title: Re-run the grid on Chrome 153 where integer hints are honoured
openQuestions.detail: On this sandbox build every hint grants 128, so the suspend table's three rows legitimately coincide at frame 512. On Chrome 153 the same run should land at 512 / 512 / 2048 for the 128 / 512 / 2048 grids, and the out-of-range probes should switch to NotSupportedError passes. The page states this; it still needs the confirming run.

openQuestions.title: Cover multiple suspends on one context
openQuestions.detail: The spec forbids scheduling two suspends that quantize to the same frame; a follow-up interaction could demonstrate that DataError/InvalidStateError branch on a coarse grid where two distinct times collide on one boundary.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic tables with captions and scoped headers; announce async results via a polite live region; native buttons with clear names.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All three result tables are captioned with th scope=col; the shared #status role=status region announces each action's completion.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide content scrolls in its own overflow container; avoid fixed layout widths on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each table sits in an overflow-x:auto .table-wrap with a min-width; control rows wrap; code tokens use overflow-wrap:anywhere.

guidanceConsulted.query: live audio demo controls with real-time readouts and aria-live status updates
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair visual table updates with a text status announcement so non-visual users know the action completed.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every button writes a completion sentence into the aria-live status pointing at the section whose table changed.

summary: OfflineAudioContext angle nothing in v145 covered: hardware≡default verification, §2.5 out-of-range NotSupportedError probes (honestly reported as not thrown by this sandbox build), and suspend() boundary quantization measured from a real offline render — currentTime landed on frame 512 for a 10 ms suspend on the 128-frame grid, exactly the spec's rounded-up boundary.
